Practised identifying one-third as one of three equal parts.
Nisha noticed when circle parts were different sizes, they were not one-third.

A word problem about one-third of 15 pencils was not completed; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares using pictures and sharing examples. Nisha explained that three unequal pieces are not one-third, and this idea was repeated correctly later in the lesson. The pencils question caused some confusion and was not completed. At home, share 12 objects into 3 equal groups and ask how many are in one group.
